newsitem.title: UK: Lowndes says has offers from 85 pct Fenchurch shrs.
newsitem.headline: Lowndes says has offers from 85 pct Fenchurch shrs.

text.p: British insurance brokers Lowndes Lambert Group Holdings Plc said on Monday that it had received valid acceptances from holders of 85.1 percent share capital in Fenchurch Plc regarding its merger with Lowndes.
These acceptances also cover 32 percent of shareholding in Fenchurch which are the subject of irrevocable undertakings to accept the merger offer given by its directors.
The two insurance broking firms agreed to merger last month to form a new company to be called Lambert Fenchurch Group.
Fenchurch shareholders are being offered 628 new Lambert Fenchurch shares for every 1,000 Fenchurch shares, they said.

The merger, the latest evidence of consolidation in the UK insurance industry which has been hit by declining premiums, values Fenchurch's issued and to be issued share capital at about 27.6 million stg.
